sections.section_name: Section C - Mental Maths & Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks correctly: a) 10 + ___ = 15.  b) The shape of a coin is a ___.  c) Sunday comes after ___.  d) 20 - 5 = ___.
questions.answer: a) 5, b) Circle, c) Saturday, d) 15

questions.question_text: Match the following numbers to their correct groups: 1) 1 Ten and 4 Ones, 2) 2 Tens, 3) 5 + 5 + 5. MATCH WITH -> (A) 15, (B) 14, (C) 20.
questions.answer: 1 matches with (B) 14, 2 matches with (C) 20, 3 matches with (A) 15

sections.section_name: Section D - Application and Problem Solving

questions.question_text: Lina goes to a toy shop. She wants to buy a doll that costs ₹15. She gives a ₹20 note to the shopkeeper. How much change will the shopkeeper give back to Lina?
questions.answer: Cost of the doll = ₹15. Amount given = ₹20. Change to get back = ₹20 - ₹15 = ₹5. The shopkeeper will return ₹5.

questions.question_text: In a fruit basket, there are 6 apples, 4 bananas, and 2 oranges. 1) How many fruits are there in total? 2) Which fruit is the least in number?
questions.answer: 1) Total fruits = 6 apples + 4 bananas + 2 oranges = 12 fruits. 2) The fruit least in number is the orange (only 2).
